newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR weaker on high liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR weaker on high liquidity.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) slipped across all maturities on Wednesday due to the high liquidity in the system, traders said.
"It's the liquidity which is driving the rates downward," one trader said, adding that the swap market ignored the firm quotes in the spot market.
"There are many maturing corporate placements today," he added.
PHIBOR are swap rates quoted by 20 banks operating in the country. The swap rates follow their corresponding spot rates, but the liquidity situation would ultimately influence swap rates.
